statement.title: Clifford involution groups in no Pauli MASA
statement.full_tex:
Let $\mathcal G\cong\F_2^r$ be a group, modulo signs, of commuting traceless Hermitian three-qubit Clifford involutions and $I$, in which every $g\ne I$ is a Pauli or has four-term support spanning a Lagrangian, and which lies in no Pauli MASA\@. Then, after a left Clifford conjugation and a change of generators, $\mathcal G$ is generated by
\[
\hat X_1,\hat X_2,\qquad\text{or}\qquad \hat X_1,\hat X_2,Z_3,\qquad\text{or}\qquad \hat X_1,\hat X_2,\hat X_3,
\]
where $\hat X_j=QX_jQ$ and $Q=\CCZ$.

finite_domain: The 63 nonidentity Paulis and the 3,780 traceless non-Pauli sign involutions in Pauli MASAs, up to sign.

covered_subclaims: The orbit computation of the paper with signed Pauli actions: one orbit of non-Pauli elements, 48 second generators in one stabilizer orbit, 12 third generators in three orbits of size four, and the normal forms.

remaining_work: No verifier of supplied evidence separate from the recomputation.

checker_conventions: paper/conventions.json; each checker states its coordinate order in its docstring
